source: Editorial task: explain the proposed bursary to prospective applicants. The board has published a draft; applications are not open. If approved in March, applications would open in May. The draft proposes 25 awards; no awards have been made.

idea.title: What the draft bursary would offer
idea.description: Explain the proposed awards and the approval condition before applications can open.
idea.rationale: The draft provides an early view of a possible application opportunity.
idea.evidence: Draft proposes 25 awards, conditional on March approval.
